channel.description:
Eagle Bed makes upholstered beds by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Every bed is made to order on a solid wood frame: ottoman and gas lift storage beds, Chesterfield, wingback, panel and fluted beds, divan beds with drawers, kids beds and headboards. We also sell UK-made mattresses.

New Shorts twice a day: a different real bed from our range each time, with the link to shop it.

Fabrics include plush velvet, chenille, linen and teddy boucle in solid colours, stripes and two-tone. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home.

Free delivery across Great Britain by our own team, usually in 3-5 working days. 14-day free returns. 5-year frame warranty (mattresses: 5-year guarantee). Pay by card, PayPal, Klarna or Clearpay.

Shop: https://www.eaglebed.co.uk
Call: 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri 9am-6pm)
Instagram @eaglebed.co.uk | TikTok @eagle.bed

longIdeas.title: Ottoman bed or divan bed? How a gas lift bed works
facts: A gas lift bed uses hydraulic gas struts to lift the whole mattress platform on a hinge, opening the storage underneath without taking the mattress off (Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base page).
A divan is an upholstered box base, usually with drawers or with no storage (same page).
Gas lift base from £220.99 in Single 3ft (current listing).
longIdeas.evidence: Search Console (voice.json, last 3 months): 'divan vs ottoman' 174 impressions, 'how do ottoman beds work' 128, 'what is gas lift storage bed' 69.
longIdeas.footage: Owner films the lift opening and closing on a real bed in the workshop.

longIdeas.title: What is a Chesterfield bed? Chesterfield, wingback and panel styles
facts: Chesterfield beds have a button-tufted headboard (Royal Chesterfield page).
Wingback beds have side wings on the headboard; we have 33 products in the Wingback Beds collection and 14 in Chesterfield Beds.
All are fully upholstered on solid wood frames, made to order in Dewsbury.
longIdeas.evidence: 'what is a chesterfield bed' 122 impressions at position 25.9.
longIdeas.footage: Existing cinema clips plus phone close-ups of buttons and wings.

longIdeas.title: UK bed sizes explained: single to super king
facts: Single 3ft 90x190cm, Small Double 4ft 120x190cm, Double 4ft6 135x190cm, King 5ft 150x200cm, Super King 6ft 180x200cm (mattress pages).
Kids beds also come in Kids Single 2.6ft.
Our bed sizes guide is on the site.
longIdeas.evidence: 'mattress sizes uk' and size questions in Search Console.
longIdeas.footage: Tape-measure shots on real beds; on-screen size table.

longIdeas.title: Choosing your fabric: velvet, chenille, linen or teddy boucle
facts: Fabrics listed on product pages: Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen, Crushed Velvet, Coniston, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé.
Solid colours, stripes and two-tone only.
Free fabric swatches to check colours at home.
longIdeas.evidence: Velvet and fabric questions in Search Console are small (single figures); this video mainly helps people decide.
longIdeas.footage: Swatch close-ups (existing eb-short-swatches.mp4 as the start).

facts: Built on a solid wood frame and upholstered by hand, made to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire.

14-day free returns (unused, unassembled, original packaging, we collect); 5-year frame warranty (mattresses: 5-year guarantee).
